tokens.name: sage-green
tokens.usage: Nature, community, stability, growth. Used as background on `header`, `.calendar-day.header`, `.event-date`; text on `.page-header h1`, `.section-header h2`, `.card h3`; border on `.metric-card`, `.meeting-item`. 4.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: warm-terracotta
tokens.usage: Home warmth, earth, belonging. Used as border on `.metric-card.terracotta`, `.project-card`; background on `.section-header .btn`, `.progress-fill`.

tokens.name: soft-cream
tokens.usage: Comfort, residential, approachable. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Clear communication, trust, notices. Used as background on `.announcements-banner`, `.event-rsvp`; border on `.metric-card.blue`; text on `.meeting-link`. 2.6:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
